name: EverMemOS

paper.title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning

stages.ingestion: An LLM-prompted Semantic Boundary Detector runs over a sliding window of the dialogue stream and cuts it into episode histories at topic shifts.
stages.construction: Each episode history is rewritten into a third-person Episode narrative (coreferences resolved), from which the LLM derives Atomic Facts and time-bounded Foresight signals with validity intervals; these plus metadata form a MemCell.
stages.organization: MemCells are incrementally clustered into thematic MemScenes (embedding similarity to scene centroid above threshold tau, with a max time-gap constraint); a user profile of explicit facts and implicit traits sits alongside.
stages.update: When a MemCell joins a MemScene the scene summary is updated and the user profile is refreshed from scene summaries with recency-aware updates and conflict tracking.
stages.retrieval: Dense (Qwen3-Embedding-4B) + BM25 over Atomic Facts fused by RRF; MemScenes scored by max member relevance (top N=10), Episodes pooled and re-ranked (Qwen3-Reranker-4B, K=10); an LLM sufficiency check triggers query rewriting (2-3 follow-up queries) when context is insufficient.
stages.answer: Reasoning mode answers from retrieved Episodes only; Chat mode additionally adds the User Profile and time-valid Foresight.

summary: Engram-inspired memory lifecycle: dialogue is segmented into MemCells (episode narrative, atomic facts, time-bounded foresight), clustered online into MemScenes with a user profile, and recalled via scene-guided agentic retrieval with a sufficiency check.
notes: AXES-CHECK: selection is broader than 'Emb-4B + BM25 + Reranker-4B' - retrieval is scene-guided (MemScene scored by max MemCell relevance) and includes an LLM sufficiency verifier with query rewriting (second round triggered for 31.0% of LoCoMo questions, App. A.1). Dense+BM25 run over Atomic Facts, reranker over Episodes. Venue: ACL 2026 long paper (aclanthology 2026.acl-long.2125); ACL version gives code URL https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverOS. Text read from the HF paper.md mirror of the arXiv paper (matches the ACL abstract).
